manifest.author: Bill Whalen
manifest.description: Creates, updates, lists, imports, and exports RAPP project tracking records stored as JSON in Azure File Storage.
manifest.name: @discreetRappers/project_tracker_agent

action.description: The action to perform on project data

agents.description: Array of agent names assigned to this project

agents_catalog.description: Agents catalog with builtin and custom arrays for update_agents_catalog action

completed_steps.description: Array of completed RAPP step numbers for update action

current_step.description: Current RAPP step number (1-14) for update action

customer_name.description: Customer name (required for create, optional for update)

description.description: Full project description with business context

discovery_data.description: Full discovery data including problemStatements, dataSources, stakeholders, successCriteria, timeline, suggestedAgents, riskFactors

generated_code.description: Generated agent code including agent_name, class_name, file_name, code content, and features

import_data.description: Full AIdeate JSON data structure with projects, agents, and timeline arrays for bulk import

mvp_document.description: MVP Poke document including full document text, features (p0/p1/p2), outOfScope, successMetrics, estimatedDays

project_date.description: Project start date in YYYY-MM-DD format (optional)

project_id.description: The unique project ID (required for update, get, delete, export)

project_name.description: Project name (required for create, optional for update)

qg_results.description: Quality gate results keyed by gate (QG1-QG6). Each contains decision, score, concerns, recommendations

status.description: Project status: planning, poc, active, production, on-hold, completed

step_artifacts.description: Additional artifacts from each step keyed by step number

step_checklists.description: Object mapping step number strings to checklist completion objects. Example: {"1": {"item1": true}}

step_decisions.description: Object mapping step number strings to quality gate decisions. Valid: PASS, FAIL, CLARIFY, COMPLETE, HOLD

step_notes.description: Object mapping step number strings to note text. Example: {"1": "Discovery completed"}

timeline_event.description: Timeline event with date, title, and description fields

type.description: Project type/industry (e.g., legal, customer-service, banking, pharma)

user_guid.description: User GUID to scope projects to a specific user
